title: Tight-envelope closure test
question: Can the six F-AHL10 wet/dry fidelity failures be closed by one further bounded tightening of the derivative-consistent retention and/or conductivity error envelope, without changing solver policy or response gates?
capacity_policy: C remains the exact derivative of the same Hermite retention interpolant; independent logC ceiling remains 1e-2.
stop_rule: If both1 does not close all six cases, stop global tolerance tightening and redesign the adaptive error metric around solver-relevant local response instead of adding more global knots.
